thread:
maya: Heads-up — after yesterday's marketplace image update we're seeing a regression on several Dedicated clusters. Long-generation jobs OOM or stall around token 4096 with driver 530 + CUDA 12.1.
jorge: Oof. Which pool? any replicable logs?
maya: gpu-pool-2 and gpu-pool-5. Quick paste of `nvidia-smi` from one node: ```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 530.41.03    Driver Version: 530.41.03    CUDA Version: 12.1     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
maya: Container image is redwood/dedicated:stable-2026-03-19 (we pulled marketplace v1.2.0).
olga: Do we also see the issue on ROCm nodes or just NV?
maya: NV only so far. AMD nodes (ROCm 5.7) appear fine on same workloads.
kevin: Any stacktraces? kernel OOM or user-space?
maya: User-space OOM inside our runtime, logs show allocation failures around kv-cache growth. Short log: `AllocationError: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` right before stall.
ashley: @maya can you run a canary with driver 525 pinned? Marketplace team can push a temp image if needed.
maya: Yes, spinning up a 525 image now (redwood/dedicated:pin-525) — will report in ~10m.
deploy-bot: deploy started by ashley -> redwood/dedicated:pin-525 to gpu-pool-2 (canary: 2 nodes).
jorge: Also flagging model-quantization path: do we run int8 kernels that changed with 530? 530 has new cuBLAS/cuDNN behaviours.
olga: cc @nvidia-eng for visibility — could be a driver-side allocator change.
nvidia-eng: Thanks for the ping. We've seen allocator changes in 530.x that affect persistent buffer growth in some runtimes. Can you share minimal repro (image + prompt config)?
maya: Sharing repro privately (pairing with infra). Prompt is long chat context ~5k tokens leading to growing kv-cache.
kevin: If repro is kv-cache growth, temporary mitigation = cap prefix cache size or fall back to smaller context in canary. We should also test with env var `TF_GPU_ALLOCATOR=cuda_malloc_async` (if supported) or runtime-specific allocator toggles.
maya: Tried `cuda_malloc_async` — no change. 525 canary booted and the job completed successfully on the two nodes.
ashley: That's encouraging. Next steps: marketplace team rolls a temporary pin image (v1.2.1-pin-525) and we coordinate partner comms.
olga: @amd-eng can you verify ROCm builds in marketplace CI didn't change? We need to ensure we don't accidentally pin ROCm.
amd-eng: ROCm CI unchanged; we won't pin. We're good.
jorge: Action items: 1) Marketplace to publish pin-525 image and prevent auto-roll for NV drivers for 48h. 2) Infra to roll back pools to driver 525 where necessary. 3) Eng-ML to reproduce with minimal test and share to NVIDIA. 4) Communications: short note to affected customers + partner update.
ashley: I'll own #1 and #4. Putting a hold on the automatic driver rollout job in the marketplace pipeline.
ashley: Draft for partner/message: "We've detected a regression with NVIDIA driver 530.x affecting large-context generations on Dedicated. We're pinning images to 525 while we investigate; no action required if you are on hosted Redwood API. Customers on Dedicated will get a targeted update. We're coordinating with NVIDIA and will post a full postmortem." Thoughts?
jorge: Good. Add expected ETA and contact for urgent issues (support@redwood.ai). Also mention mitigations (pin-525, temporary cache cap).
kevin: I'll add a quick runbook for on-call: how to identify the OOM signature and apply the pin image via `kubectl set image` snippet.
maya: Confirming canary nodes stayed healthy after pin. Will start a broader rollout to gpu-pool-5 in 30m.
nvidia-eng: We're triaging with driver team. If you can attach the minimal repro and perf traces we'll prioritize.
ashley: marketplace: rolling v1.2.1-pin-525 now and adding a guard to the deploy pipeline. ETA ~20m.
olga: Also add a note in the hardware partner channel so integrators (SI) don't auto-update their images.
amd-eng: Acknowledged.
deploy-bot: rollout completed: redwood/dedicated:v1.2.1-pin-525 deployed to gpu-pool-2 (2 nodes) and gpu-pool-5 (3 nodes).
maya: Post-rollout check: all current long-run jobs completed successfully on pinned image. No new regressions observed in the last 45m.
jorge: Great. After NVIDIA provides patch guidance we can plan either a driver bump or a runtime workaround. Keep this thread updated.
maya: Adding short repro + logs to the NVIDIA ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
